text: Money for ever!” “So am I, and so, I am afraid, are most of my acquaintances at Swanage, but I am surprised that you agree with us.” “Thank you so much, Aunt Juley. While I have talked theories, you have done the flowers.” “Not at all, dear. I wish you would let me help you in more important things.” “Well, would you be very kind? Would you come round with me to the registry office? There’s a housemaid who won’t say yes but doesn’t say no.” On their way thither they too looked up at the Wilcoxes’ flat.
